stem: An analyst reports the repeat purchase rate as the orders placed by customers with two or more orders, divided by all orders. Why is this not the repeat purchase rate?

options.text: The repeat purchase rate divides by the customers who placed no order
It leaves out the guest orders, which belong in the denominator of the rate
It divides orders, not customers, so frequent buyers count once per order
It should divide by the orders of the customers who bought only once
